enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to shoulders. Adjust pillow under head. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Remain still. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Turn to left side again. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Splash water on face. Pick up soap. Rub soap on hands. Apply soap to face. Rinse face with water. Pick up towel. Dry face with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste to toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, and bread. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Flip eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait for toast. Take out plate. Take out glass. Pour milk into glass. Place plate and glass on table. Sit on chair. Pick up fork. Cut eggs. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Eat toast. Finish meal. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to sink. Place dishes in sink. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open work bag. Place stethoscope in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Place phone in bag. Place charger in bag. Close work bag. Look in mirror. Adjust collar. Pick up work bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust rearview mirror. Adjust side mirror. Press accelerator. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Wait. Press accelerator. Drive. Turn steering wheel. Park car in hospital parking lot. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open car door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: patient care and ward duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Take off outer clothes. Put on scrubs. Close locker. Walk to ward. Pick up patient chart. Read chart. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Measure temperature. Measure pulse. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Write notes. Exit patient room. Walk to next patient room. Repeat. Attend ward meeting. Discuss patient cases. Write reports. Walk to supply room. Pick up supplies. Return to ward. Restock supplies. Talk to colleague. Walk to nursing station. Use computer. Enter patient data. Answer phone. Talk to doctor. Walk to patient room. Assist patient.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Place food on tray. Pick up drink. Pay at cashier. Walk to table. Sit on chair. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink beverage. Talk to colleague. Finish meal. Pick up tray. Walk to trash. Dispose waste. Place tray on rack. Walk out of cafeteria.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work and patient care duties
enriched_activities.desc: Return to ward. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Check IV drip. Adjust flow rate. Change bandage. Administer injection. Talk to patient. Monitor patient. Write notes. Walk to nursing station. Answer phone. Talk to family member. Update patient records. Walk to X-ray room. Assist patient. Return to ward. Attend training session. Take notes. Walk to supply room. Pick up gloves. Put on gloves.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Press accelerator. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Wait. Press accelerator. Drive. Turn steering wheel. Park car in driveway. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open car door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add seasoning. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Set table. Sit on chair. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Place plate in sink. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom. Put on pajamas. Walk back to bathroom. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Type on keyboard. Browse internet. Check email. Watch video. Put laptop down. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Continue browsing. Close laptop. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reading and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Change into pajamas. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Sleep.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Remain still. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Turn to left side. Sleep. Wake up briefly. Turn over. Sleep.
